mapper.select: SELECT recognition_id, company_id, employee_id, attendance_source_id, source_business_key, source_version, oa_attendance_document_id, business_date, expected_interval_start, expected_interval_end, overtime_type, recognized_minutes, knowledge_at, reason, created_by, audit_reference, user_confirmation_text, user_confirmation_sha256, evidence_sha256, request_id, reversed_at, reversed_by, reversal_reason, reversal_request_id FROM attendance_report_oa_overtime_recognition WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND oa_attendance_document_id = #{oaAttendanceDocumentId}

SELECT recognition_id, company_id, employee_id, attendance_source_id, source_business_key, source_version, oa_attendance_document_id, business_date, expected_interval_start, expected_interval_end, overtime_type, recognized_minutes, knowledge_at, reason, created_by, audit_reference, user_confirmation_text, user_confirmation_sha256, evidence_sha256, request_id, reversed_at, reversed_by, reversal_reason, reversal_request_id FROM attendance_report_oa_overtime_recognition WHERE recognition_id = #{recognitionId}

SELECT oa.oa_attendance_document_id AS oaAttendanceDocumentId, oa.document_type AS documentType, oa.source_status AS sourceStatus, normalized.validation_status AS validationStatus, normalized.interval_start AS intervalStart, normalized.interval_end AS intervalEnd, matched.match_status AS matchStatus, matched.employee_id AS employeeId, employee.company_id AS companyId, employee.employee_number AS employeeNumber, context.activation_decision AS activationDecision, context.overtime_type AS overtimeType FROM oa_attendance_document oa JOIN normalized_attendance_record normalized ON normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id = oa.normalized_attendance_record_id AND normalized.validation_status = 'VALID' JOIN raw_attendance_fact raw ON raw.raw_attendance_fact_id = normalized.raw_attendance_fact_id JOIN employee_match_decision matched ON matched.normalized_attendance_record_id = normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id AND matched.match_status = 'MATCHED' JOIN employee employee ON employee.employee_id = matched.employee_id LEFT JOIN oa_attendance_document_context context ON context.oa_attendance_document_id = oa.oa_attendance_document_id WHERE oa.oa_attendance_document_id = #{oaAttendanceDocumentId} AND oa.attendance_source_id = #{attendanceSourceId} AND raw.source_business_key = #{sourceBusinessKey} AND oa.source_version = #{sourceVersion}

WITH ranked_doc AS ( SELECT doc.oa_attendance_document_id, doc.attendance_source_id, doc.source_business_key, doc.source_version, doc.source_status, doc.document_type, doc.normalized_attendance_record_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY doc.attendance_source_id, doc.source_business_key ORDER BY doc.knowledge_rank DESC, doc.created_at DESC, doc.oa_attendance_document_id DESC) AS rk FROM oa_attendance_document doc WHERE doc.created_at <= #{asOf} AND doc.attendance_source_id = #{attendanceSourceId} ) SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ranked_doc doc JOIN normalized_attendance_record norm ON norm.normalized_attendance_record_id = doc.normalized_attendance_record_id AND norm.validation_status = 'VALID' JOIN raw_attendance_fact raw ON raw.raw_attendance_fact_id = norm.raw_attendance_fact_id JOIN employee_match_decision matched ON matched.normalized_attendance_record_id = norm.normalized_attendance_record_id AND matched.match_status = 'MATCHED' JOIN employee emp ON emp.employee_id = matched.employee_id LEFT JOIN oa_attendance_document_context ctx ON ctx.oa_attendance_document_id = doc.oa_attendance_document_id WHERE doc.rk = 1 AND doc.oa_attendance_document_id <> #{excludeDocId} AND doc.source_business_key <> #{excludeKey} AND matched.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND emp.company_id = #{companyId} AND doc.document_type = 'OVERTIME' AND raw.source_business_key = doc.source_business_key AND ( doc.source_status IN ('APPROVED', 'MODIFIED', 'SUPPLEMENTED', 'PENDING') OR (doc.source_status = 'UNKNOWN' AND doc.source_version REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])T([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]([.][0-9]{1,9})?:state=0:Asia/Shanghai$') ) AND ctx.activation_decision = 'ACTIVATED' AND ctx.overtime_type IS NOT NULL AND norm.interval_start < #{intervalEnd} AND norm.interval_end > #{intervalStart} AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_report_oa_evidence_exclusion ex WHERE ex.oa_attendance_document_id = doc.oa_attendance_document_id AND ex.company_id = #{companyId} AND ex.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ex.attendance_source_id = doc.attendance_source_id AND ex.source_business_key = doc.source_business_key AND ex.source_version = doc.source_version AND ex.knowledge_at <= #{asOf} AND (ex.reversed_at IS NULL OR ex.reversed_at > #{asOf}) ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_report_oa_overtime_recognition ( recognition_id, company_id, employee_id, attendance_source_id, source_business_key, source_version, oa_attendance_document_id, business_date, expected_interval_start, expected_interval_end, overtime_type, recognized_minutes, knowledge_at, reversed_at, reason, created_by, audit_reference, user_confirmation_text, user_confirmation_sha256, evidence_sha256, request_id, reversed_by, reversal_reason, reversal_request_id ) VALUES ( #{recognitionId}, #{companyId}, #{employeeId}, #{attendanceSourceId}, #{sourceBusinessKey}, #{sourceVersion}, #{oaAttendanceDocumentId}, #{businessDate}, #{expectedIntervalStart}, #{expectedIntervalEnd}, #{overtimeType}, #{recognizedMinutes}, #{knowledgeAt}, NULL, #{reason}, #{createdBy}, #{auditReference}, #{userConfirmationText}, #{userConfirmationSha256}, #{evidenceSha256}, #{requestId}, NULL, NULL, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT attendance_source_id FROM attendance_source WHERE attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND source_type = 'OA_ATTENDANCE' AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_report_oa_overtime_recognition SET reversed_at = #{reversedAt}, reversed_by = #{reversedBy}, reversal_reason = #{reversalReason}, reversal_request_id = #{reversalRequestId} WHERE recognition_id = #{recognitionId} AND reversed_at IS NULL
